+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M21AHDHY0H7A92PP2KTRTZEZ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: a280
+title: 'MessageActions: copy, copy thread, export Markdown, retry, edit; per-message selection (plan §9 A, §11#8, research R10)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Items/MessageActions.swift` and `ThreadExporter.swift`, per plan.md §9 A and decision 8. This task also settles research R10 with a hosted test.
+
+- `MessageActions(message:)`: a footer row with Copy (the message text as Markdown), Copy thread, Export thread as Markdown (`fileExporter`), Retry (calls `send` with the last user input; assistant messages only), and Edit (loads the text into the composer; user messages only). Buttons are `.glass` secondary.
+- `ThreadExporter.markdown(for thread: AgentThread) -> String`: user and assistant messages as headed sections, reasoning as a quoted block, tool calls as a fenced JSON summary, and structured items as fenced JSON.
+- Per-message selection: apply `.textSelection(.enabled)` on the message content. Write a hosted test that checks if a drag across two message rows selects across both on macOS 27. Record the result in the file header. If it selects across rows, decision 8 is relaxed in the plan; if not, the per-message bar stands.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Copy puts the message Markdown on the pasteboard.
+- [ ] Export produces a Markdown document with one section per message in order.
+- [ ] Retry calls `send` with the last user input; Edit sets the composer text.
+- [ ] The cross-row selection test records a pass or fail and the file header states which.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Items/ThreadExporterTests.swift`: a golden Markdown file for a fixture thread.
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Items/MessageActionsHostedTests.swift`: the four actions through an injected pasteboard and `NoopThreadActions`; the selection probe.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
